verdict.rationale: Lithic documents Card and Account Spend Limits for managing spend velocity (lithic-docs-13). Its Authorization Rules engine applies at program, account, or card level and is enforced by Lithic "without managing additional infrastructure" (lithic-docs-3, lithic-docs-17). Lithic also says these rules can control transaction limits and velocity (lithic-docs-11). missing for 10: explicit evidence of daily/monthly/all-time window options, explicit transaction-count (vs amount) velocity rules, confirmation that account-level maps to per-cardholder limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
